basic_info.description: Light and bright 3 bedroom, 2 bathroom home in Silver Terrace! On the main level the property boasts an ample sized living room framed by a wall of windows, two large bedrooms and a full size bathroom with glass enclosed shower and skylight. Also on the main level is the kitchen with stainless steel appliances, gas cooktop, skylight and breakfast nook. The kitchen connects directly with the dining room, with ample space and beautiful city / bay views, providing the perfect space for everyday dining and entertaining. On the lower level is another bedroom, office and full size bathroom with stall shower and direct access to the backyard with deck, patio and flat yard which all face expansive views. Also on the lower level is the garage and laundry area. This appealing home provides a wonderful lifestyle as well as absolute convenience with quick access to Muni and multiple highways.
